I am 72, this product is the best of all the high dollar products that I have spent hundreds of dollars in the past, I could tell a big difference in just a week, my wrinkles are much softer, my complexion has a great feel like its soft as satin

avis.titre: Magic in a little pink bottle
avis.texte: I picked this up on a recent trip to Ulta after hearing so much talk online about this brand. I also recently began following a beauty influencer who has been singing the praises of PDRN, which I didn't realize until *after* I applied the mask is… salmon DNA (I was going to use another word, but I don't want my review to get flagged lol). I have no clue how they collect that ingredient but whatever it is, it's literally magic. I have only used this twice and I have woken up so glowy and soft that I am now excited to make this a part of my skin care routine. Not only does it work really well, it's a fun process as the mass has a hint of sparkle to it (what does that do? Dont care!) and as a certified anxious, thicker, it is so satisfying to peel off the next day. Currently, I'm just using it weekly and even if the only temporary, it makes me feel refreshed and ready for the day when I wake up.
Cool feeling - super fun to peel it off in the am. Good smell too.

avis.titre: Wake up with hydrated, bouncy skin
avis.texte: I'm 60 years old and this mask is my secret to waking up with beautiful, bouncy hydrated skin. One of my all time favorite products
I use multiple Medicube products and this one did not disappoint. I love the flattening effect and smoothed lines by morning.

avis.titre: Love this product! wish it came in a bigger size
avis.texte: This was the very first night wrapping mask that I've purchased and I was very impressed. I made sure to let all of my skincare dry down before I put this on, and to put it in a thin layer. It took maybe 10 minutes to dry, and was very comfortable for overnight. My skin is very sensitive and I didn't have any issue with this product. My skin was surprisingly calm and glowy in the morning! I didn't notice any difference with plumping fine lines, but the glow and softness was enough for me.

avis.titre: Fun to use and keeps skincare on my face at night
avis.texte: I'm really enjoyung this product so far! It's the last step in your skincare routine— don't apply to bare face. I cleanse, tone, then apply serum and then a pretty thick later of medicube PDRN pink collagen moisturizer. I let that set then apply this. My first try I used too little and the thin layer was harder ro peel off in the meoning. I learned that using a thicker layer of the wrapping mask helps me peel it off more easily. I avoid my hairline, eyes, and mouth and don't bother with my upper lip. It peels off in nice big pieces and stays on all through the night. I sleep on my face (satin pillowcase) and move around a lot in my sleep and it stays put! I love that my skincare is all staying on my face and not smearing all over my pillowcase throughout the night, and it's fun to peel it off in the morning. Is it gimmicky? Sure. But I like using it. It's fun! I live in the desert, so keeping my skin hydrated while I sleep is a big priority. And I love that I'm not wasting my expensive skincare products on my bed linens.

It never fully set and felt sticky which is u comfortable when uour trying to sleep… both nights i had to peel it off halfway through the night. I guess if you can wear it the whole night you may have diferent results.
I highly recommend this product. I use this nightly with my skin care routine. Ive been using it only a few weeks & already see a difference.

I started a new moisturizer and started using this a couple of times a week at the same time, at first, I had the most glowy nice skin and I could see some fine lines reduced. I was so happy. After a couple of weeks my skin went completely crazy, got a couple of red painful rashes in my cheeks with tiny bubbles in them, skin started flaking around eyebrows and near one of the rashes, area around my lips was tender and peeling as well. I stopped everything and focused on recovering my skin with gentle products and zero active ingredients, at the time I thought it was the moisturizer that gave me a reaction. After about a month my skin was still not the same, I would get better and then flare up a bit again, until finally I got to a good stage where most stuff was gone and you could only see a bit of red hue where the bigger rash was. I got to a point where I could wear makeup and look as if nothing had happened. At that point, silly me having an important event, used this mask to get more glowy skin, and I did! The next day I looked great. Then, everything flared up again overnight as if I had made no progress at all. Now I know it was not the moisturizer but this, burned through my skin barrier or something. Now I'm off to recover again, lesson learned!

I liked it, it dried fast, it was comfortable to sleep in, and most of all, I DIDN'T BREAK OUT BECAUSE OF IT! The only thing is, I didn't see any crazy results. All that changed was it made my oily skin calm down so it's a little dry now.
This is like putting plastic wrap on your face overnight. I never get pimples but this made my skin break out.

avis.titre: in love after using only once
avis.texte: Im obsessed, this product makes my skin feel so bouncy, fresh, shiny and hydrated.
